said: ## Sampling design Fourteen sampling units were selected within forest patches, distributed across five municipalities (Supplementary Information Table S1 and Fig 1) in the Metropolitan Region of Salvador, all composed of Dense Ombrophilous Forest vegetation.
All sampled forest patches were in reasonable shape, composed of arboreal vegetation with canopy cover, and were within the urban matrix.
From July to October 2012, 10 sample points were distributed 30 m apart within each forest patch, totaling 140 sample points for the whole study.
Three sampling methods were used to assess ants and spiders from both the soil and the vegetation.
In the soil, leaf litter animals were sampled with Winkler traps in 50 × 50 cm units and were kept there for 24 h, followed by animal extraction.
The vegetation-dwelling fauna was sampled with an entomological umbrella (1 m 2 ) at each sample point from three bushes (from 1 to 3 m high) shaken for 10 s.
Manual diurnal capture from the soil and vegetation was also conducted for 15 min at each sample point.

basisOfRecord.quote: We sampled 14 forest areas in the Metropolitan Region of Salvador and tested the effect of the landscapes’ proportion of forest cover, mean landscape isolation, and mean landscape shape complexity on the taxonomic and functional richness and the community composition of both groups.
